007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SyntheticDataBatchRequest;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SyntheticDataObjectList;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SyntheticDataParams;
016import org.slf4j.Logger;
017import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
018
019/**
020 * Sample for generating synthetic data with a batch request.
021 *
022 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, open a
023 * {@link Profile}, build a {@link SyntheticDataBatchRequest}, and call
024 * {@link Profile#generateSyntheticData(SyntheticDataBatchRequest)}.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>This sample changes database state by generating synthetic data for one or
027 * more requested database objects.</p>
028 *
029 * <p>When running this sample individually, ensure the target table or object
030 * identified by the synthetic-data environment variables already exists and is
031 * visible to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}. The integration script creates its
032 * synthetic-data validation table before running synthetic-data samples.</p>
033 *
034 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
035 * <ul>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OBJECT_NAME</li>
041 * </ul>
042 *
043 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
044 * <ul>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OWNER_NAME - defaults to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}.</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_RECORD_COUNT</li>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_USER_PROMPT</li>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OBJECT_NAME_2</li>
049 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OWNER_NAME_2</li>
050 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_RECORD_COUNT_2</li>
051 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_USER_PROMPT_2</li>
052 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_SAMPLE_ROWS</li>
053 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_TABLE_STATISTICS</li>
054 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY</li>
055 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_COMMENTS</li>
056 * </ul>
057 *
058 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
059 * <pre>{@code
060 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
061 * }</pre>
062 *
063 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
064 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
065 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
066 * <pre>{@code
067 * mvn clean install
068 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
069 * }</pre>
070 *
071 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
072 * <pre>{@code
073 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/GenerateSyntheticDataBatchRequestSample.java
074 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.GenerateSyntheticDataBatchRequestSample
075 * }</pre>
076 *
077 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
078 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
079 * and diagnostics.</p>
080 */
081public final class GenerateSyntheticDataBatchRequestSample {
082    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GenerateSyntheticDataBatchRequestSample.class);
083
084    private GenerateSyntheticDataBatchRequestSample() {
085    }
086
087    public static void main(String[] args) {
088        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
089        String objectName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OBJECT_NAME");
090
091        try {
092            Profile profile = createSelectAI().profile(profileName);
093            SyntheticDataBatchRequest request = buildRequest(objectName);
094            boolean generated = profile.generateSyntheticData(request);
095
096            System.out.printf("Generate synthetic data batch completed: %s%n", generated);
097            System.out.printf("Object list: %s%n", request.getObjectListJson());
098        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
099            LOGGER.error("Failed to generate synthetic data batch for first object '{}'.", objectName, e);
100        }
101    }
102
103    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
104        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
105                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
106                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
107                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
108                .build();
109
110        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
111    }
112
113    private static SyntheticDataBatchRequest buildRequest(String objectName) {
114        String ownerName = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OWNER_NAME", requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"));
115        SyntheticDataBatchRequest.Builder builder = SyntheticDataBatchRequest.builder()
116                .addObject(buildObject(ownerName, objectName,
117                        optionalInteger("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_RECORD_COUNT"),
118                        optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_USER_PROMPT")))
119                .params(buildSyntheticDataParams());
120
121        String secondObjectName = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OBJECT_NAME_2");
122        if (secondObjectName != null) {
123            builder.addObject(buildObject(
124                    envOrDefault("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OWNER_NAME_2", ownerName),
125                    secondObjectName,
126                    optionalInteger("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_RECORD_COUNT_2"),
127                    optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_USER_PROMPT_2")));
128        }
129
130        return builder.build();
131    }
132
133    private static SyntheticDataObjectList buildObject(String ownerName,
134                                                       String objectName,
135                                                       Integer recordCount,
136                                                       String userPrompt) {
137        SyntheticDataObjectList.Builder builder = SyntheticDataObjectList.builder(ownerName, objectName);
138        if (recordCount != null) {
139            builder.recordCount(recordCount);
140        }
141        if (userPrompt != null && !userPrompt.isBlank()) {
142            builder.userPrompt(userPrompt);
143        }
144        return builder.build();
145    }
146
147    private static SyntheticDataParams buildSyntheticDataParams() {
148        SyntheticDataParams.Builder builder = SyntheticDataParams.builder();
149        boolean configured = false;
150
151        Integer sampleRows = optionalInteger("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_SAMPLE_ROWS");
152        if (sampleRows != null) {
153            builder.sampleRows(sampleRows);
154            configured = true;
155        }
156        Boolean tableStatistics = optionalBoolean("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_TABLE_STATISTICS");
157        if (tableStatistics != null) {
158            builder.tableStatistics(tableStatistics);
159            configured = true;
160        }
161        String priority = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY");
162        if (priority != null) {
163            builder.priority(priority);
164            configured = true;
165        }
166        Boolean comments = optionalBoolean("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_COMMENTS");
167        if (comments != null) {
168            builder.comments(comments);
169            configured = true;
170        }
171        return configured ? builder.build() : null;
172    }
173
174    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
175        String value = System.getenv(name);
176        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
177            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
178        }
179        return value;
180    }
181
182    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
183        String value = System.getenv(name);
184        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
185    }
186
187    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
188        String value = System.getenv(name);
189        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
190    }
191
192    private static Integer optionalInteger(String name) {
193        String value = optionalEnv(name);
194        return value == null ? null : Integer.valueOf(value);
195    }
196
197    private static Boolean optionalBoolean(String name) {
198        String value = optionalEnv(name);
199        return value == null ? null : Boolean.valueOf(value);
200    }
201}
